note: Core combat work lives in the vertical slice epic (18). These are the items beyond the slice.

tickets.title: Remaining weapon classes (up to five total)
tickets.description: Movesets per weapon class, not per weapon. Individual weapons differ by stats, reach and effects.

tickets.title: Parry as a rare weapon property
tickets.description: Not a universal verb. Only on specific catalogue weapons.

tickets.title: Controller enemy role
tickets.description: Debuffs, snares, summons. The priority target that teaches target prioritisation. Needs a status effect system.

tickets.title: Swarm enemy role
tickets.description: Individually trivial, dangerous in numbers. The reason area effects exist. Needs crowd handling.

tickets.title: Ambusher enemy role
tickets.description: The reason you look at terrain. Needs perception and concealment tuning.

tickets.title: Status effect system
tickets.description: Prerequisite for the Controller role and several Law axioms.

tickets.title: Encounter budget composer
tickets.description: Pick roles to fill a budget, then dress them in the region's faction and biome. One AI, dozens of faces.

tickets.title: Encounter placement clear-radius validation
tickets.description: Generator pass refusing to spawn fights inside geometry that makes them unreadable.

tickets.title: Enemy reskinning by faction and biome
tickets.description: Material parameters, scale, gear and speed over shared skeletons.

tickets.title: Remaining Law power sources: Written, Ley-bound, Borrowed
tickets.description: Ore-bound, Blood-price and Dying land earlier. Ley-bound needs a spatial strength field.

tickets.title: Ley strength spatial field and positional casting
tickets.description: Magic becomes positional; holding the node is winning. The most mechanically distinct Law.

tickets.title: Enemy audio identity per role
tickets.description: Distinct wind-up sounds per role, plus footstep material detection.

tickets.title: Silhouette validation against dense foliage
tickets.description: Test every enemy shape against the most common thing the PCG pass produces.
